# kayjs-cms

> A CMS for kay sites: content edited on the page it renders, and collection screens.

## Topics

- [Setup and saving files](llms/setup.md): `kay add cms`, `forgejo()`, `workingTree()`, a saver of your own, and how a save names the version it was made from so editors never overwrite each other
- [Options of cms()](llms/options.md): `prefix`, `logo`, `role`, `guard`, `files` and the `CMS_*` variables, `uploads` and their checks, `pageSize`, `collections`, `rawHtml`, `author`, `onSave`, sign-in and roles
- [The editor on the page](llms/editor.md): edit mode, the markers kay writes, the panel, unsaved drafts, the entries API and the dev tool tab
- [The admin screens](llms/admin.md): each screen under `<prefix>`: content list, entry form, new entry, translations, media, unused uploads and missing pages
- [Arranging and replacing the screens](llms/screens.md): `cms({ collections })` for a form's field order, rows and hidden fields and a list's columns and row actions
- [Replacing a screen and building one from parts](llms/screens-replacing.md): an app page at a screen path, `createEntryForm` and the entry parts, fixing a refused save
- [Uploads and image fields](llms/uploads.md): what a file or image field does, the upload route and its limits, the picker, alt text and sizes kept beside an image, and the unused-uploads screen
- [History, the trash and the activity log](llms/history.md): the last 50 saves of a loaded entry and its deleted entries for 30 days, restorable, and who did what, kept by default; `cms({ history })` and a loader's `sibling`
- [Loaders and a live CMS](llms/loaders.md): `sqliteLoader` and `pgLoader`, seeding, all-or-nothing saves of several entries, the steps to wire editors saving on a running site, how other processes and outside edits are followed (`watch`), and `onSave`
- [Edit this page link](llms/page-links.md): the link an editor's browser finds on each page, `pageLink: false`, a link of your own, and how an entry finds its page
- [Field kinds and entering a field](llms/fields.md): `fieldInput` (placeholder, unit, rows, labels, lines, when), what the schema sets, `customField`, `blocks`, ready-made kinds (`colorField`, `moneyField`, `tagsField`, `linkField`, `geoField`, `iconField`)
- [Form fields and drafts](llms/api.md): `fieldsOf`, `fieldOf`, `humanize`, `emptyValue`, markers, `createDrafts` and the path helpers
- [Renaming an entry's slug](llms/rename.md): the Rename button, the old URL redirecting by itself, a saver's `move`
- [Texts and languages](llms/words.md): the `cms.*` messages that word every text of the screens and the editor
- [Texts and languages: media to uploads](llms/words-media-to-uploads.md): the `cms.*` messages of the media, page, redirect, role, save, sign-in, store, table, trash and upload areas
